images.img1Desc: A man sits on a light grey sofa at home with a laptop on his knees. He is typing with one hand and holding a mug in the other, and is smiling. A tidy kitchen with shelves is behind him.
images.img2Desc: Many people work at computers along two long desks in a large open office. Some are typing, one wears a headset, and another is reading a sheet of paper. There are shelves and brick walls at the back.
images.pairDiff: The first shows working alone at home, the second working in a busy office.

questions.prompt: What job would you like to have in the future?
questions.sampleA2:
I want to be a teacher.

Because I like children.

And I like to read books.

It is a good job, I think.
questions.sampleB1:
In the future, I would like to be a graphic designer.

I think it's a very creative job and I like to draw.

Also, I'm good with computers, so it's a good fit for me.

I know it can be difficult to find a job, but I'm going to study hard.
questions.sampleB2: To be honest, I'd love to end up working as a UX designer. I've always been drawn to anything that combines creativity with problem-solving, and I suppose designing apps that people actually enjoy using would be really rewarding. It's a fast-growing field too, so I reckon there'd be plenty of opportunities to grow into.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men o'qituvchi bo'lishni xohlayman.

Chunki menga bolalar yoqadi.

Va men kitob o'qishni yoqtiraman.

Menimcha, bu yaxshi ish.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Kelajakda men grafik dizayner bo'lishni xohlayman.

Menimcha, bu juda ijodiy ish va men rasm chizishni yaxshi ko'raman.

Shuningdek, men kompyuterlar bilan yaxshi chiqishaman, shuning uchun bu men uchun mos keladi.

Bilaman, ish topish qiyin bo'lishi mumkin, lekin men qattiq o'qiyman.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Men kelajakda atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish sohasida ishlashni umid qilaman.

Ideal holda, men tadqiqot bilan shug'ullanmoqchiman, ehtimol barqaror qishloq xo'jaligi yoki qayta tiklanadigan energiya manbalariga e'tibor qaratgan holda.

Men uchun sayyoraga ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatadigan narsaga hissa qo'shish muhim.

Bu raqobatbardosh soha ekanligini bilsam ham, men o'zgarish qilish uchun zarur tajriba va ko'nikmalarni olishga qaror qildim.

vocabulary.title: Q1 - What job would you like to have in the future?
idioms: choose a job you love - "sevgan ishingni tanla"
sentenceStarters: "In the future, I would love to work as..." - "Kelajakda men ... bo'lib ishlashni xohlayman..."
"What attracts me to this career is..." - "Meni bu karyeraga jalb qiladigan narsa..."
"I've always been passionate about..." - "Men doimo ... ga ishtiyoqmand bo'lganman..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
In the future, I would love to work as a language consultant or interpreter. Languages have always been my passion, and I find the idea of bridging communication between different cultures incredibly fulfilling.
What attracts me to this career is the variety it offers. Every day would be different – I might be translating documents one day and interpreting at an international conference the next. It's a job that allows you to constantly learn and grow.
I also appreciate that this profession offers flexibility. I could work as a freelancer, choose my own projects, and even work remotely from anywhere in the world. As they say, "Choose a job you love, and you will never have to work a day in your life." That's exactly what I'm aiming for.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Kelajakda men til bo'yicha maslahatchi yoki tarjimon bo'lib ishlashni juda xohlardim. Tillar doim mening ishtiyoqim bo'lgan va turli madaniyatlar o'rtasida aloqani bog'lash g'oyasi meni juda qoniqtiradi.

Meni bu kasbga jalb qiladigan narsa uning xilma-xilligidir. Har bir kun har xil bo'ladi – bir kuni hujjatlarni tarjima qilishim, keyingi kuni xalqaro konferensiyada tarjimonlik qilishim mumkin. Bu sizga doimiy ravishda o'rganish va o'sish imkonini beradigan ish.

Men, shuningdek, bu kasbning moslashuvchanligini qadrlayman. Men frilanser sifatida ishlashim, o'z loyihalarimni tanlashim va hatto dunyoning istalgan nuqtasidan masofadan turib ishlashim mumkin. Aytishlaricha, "O'zingizga yoqqan ishni tanlang va hayotingizda bir kun ham ishlashingizga to'g'ri kelmaydi". Men aynan shunga intilayapman.

questions.prompt: Do you prefer working alone or in a team?
questions.sampleA1:
I like work alone.

It is good.

I like it.
questions.sampleA2:
I like working alone.

But sometimes team is good too.

Because team can help me.

I like alone more, I think.
questions.sampleB1:
I prefer working alone, I think.

It's easier for me to concentrate.

When I work in a team, there are often distractions.

However, sometimes teamwork is good for brainstorming.

For example, if I have a problem, the team can help me find a solution.
questions.sampleB2: It really depends, but on the whole I'd say I lean towards teamwork. The thing is, I find you can bounce ideas off each other and come up with far better solutions together. That said, when I really need to knuckle down and concentrate, I'd much rather work alone, so honestly a bit of both suits me best.
questions.uzSampleA2:
Men yolg'iz ishlashni yoqtiraman.

Lekin ba'zida jamoa ham yaxshi.

Chunki jamoa menga yordam berishi mumkin.

Menimcha, yolg'iz ishlash ko'proq yoqadi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Men yolg'iz ishlashni afzal ko'raman, deb o'ylayman.

Menga diqqatni jamlash osonroq.

Jamoada ishlaganimda, ko'pincha chalg'ituvchi omillar bo'ladi.

Biroq, ba'zida jamoaviy ish fikrlar almashish uchun yaxshi.

Masalan, agar menda muammo bo'lsa, jamoa menga yechim topishga yordam berishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Garchi men jamoaviy ishning hamkorlik jihatini qadrlasam-da, men odatda mustaqil ishlashni afzal ko'raman.

Men o'z vaqtimni o'zim boshqarib, vazifalarga o'zim xohlagan usulda yondashganimda, unumdorligim va diqqatim yuqori bo'lishini sezaman.

Albatta, jamoaviy ish g'oyalarni muhokama qilish va ulashish uchun qimmatli, va men uning ayrim loyihalardagi ahamiyatini tan olaman.

Biroq, menimcha, ayniqsa chuqur konsentratsiyani va individual muammolarni hal qilishni talab qiladigan vazifalarda, mustaqil ishlash uchun avtonomiyaga ega bo'lganimda, men samaraliroq hissa qo'shaman.

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Do you prefer working alone or in a team?
idioms: "Two heads are better than one" - "Ikki bosh birdan yaxshi"
sentenceStarters: "I prefer working in a team because..." - "Men jamoada ishlashni afzal ko'raman, chunki..."
"Working alone allows me to..." - "Yolg'iz ishlash menga ... imkonini beradi..."
"I think the ideal situation is..." - "Menimcha, ideal vaziyat..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
To be honest, I think I prefer a combination of both, though if I had to choose, I would lean slightly towards teamwork.
Working in a team has many advantages. You can bounce ideas off colleagues, learn from others' experiences, and share the workload. There's also a social aspect that makes work more enjoyable. I find that collaborative projects often produce better results because different people bring different perspectives and skills.
However, I also value time to work independently. Some tasks require deep concentration, and having quiet time to focus is essential. I think the ideal situation is having a balance – team brainstorming sessions combined with individual work time. As they say, "Two heads are better than one," but sometimes you need space to think.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Rostini aytsam, men ikkalasining kombinatsiyasini afzal ko'raman deb o'ylayman, lekin agar tanlashga to'g'ri kelsa, men biroz ko'proq jamoaviy ishga moyil bo'lardim.

Jamoada ishlashning ko'p afzalliklari bor. Siz hamkasblaringiz bilan fikr almashishingiz, boshqalarning tajribasidan o'rganishingiz va ish yukini baham ko'rishingiz mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ishni yanada yoqimli qiladigan ijtimoiy jihat ham mavjud. Menimcha, hamkorlikdagi loyihalar ko'pincha yaxshiroq natijalarni beradi, chunki turli odamlar turli nuqtai nazarlar va ko'nikmalarni olib kelishadi.

Biroq, men mustaqil ishlash uchun vaqtni ham qadrlayman. Ba'zi vazifalar chuqur diqqatni talab qiladi va diqqatni jamlash uchun tinch vaqtga ega bo'lish juda muhim. Menimcha, ideal holat - bu muvozanatga ega bo'lish - jamoaviy aqliy hujum sessiyalari individual ish vaqti bilan birlashtirilgan. Aytishlaricha, "Ikki bosh bir boshdan yaxshi", lekin ba'zan o'ylash uchun joy kerak.

questions.prompt: Is work-life balance important to you?
questions.sampleA1: Yes. Work... important. Family important. Happy important.
questions.sampleA2: Yes, it is important. I like work, but I also like my free time. I want to see my friends and family. It's important to have both.
questions.sampleB1: Yes, work-life balance is important to me. I think it's important to have time for work and also time for fun. If you only work, you get tired. For example, I like to play sports after work. It helps me relax. It's good for my health.
questions.sampleB2: Absolutely, I'd say it's hugely important to me. The thing is, if you throw yourself into work completely, you eventually burn out and your health takes a hit. I make a real effort to switch off in the evenings and set aside time for family, because at the end of the day, a bit of downtime keeps me sane.
questions.uzSampleA1: Ha. Ish... muhim. Oila muhim. Baxtli bo'lish muhim.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ha, bu muhim. Men ishni yaxshi ko'raman, lekin bo'sh vaqtimni ham yaxshi ko'raman. Men do'stlarim va oilamni ko'rishni xohlayman. Ikkalasiga ham ega bo'lish muhim.
questions.uzSampleB1: Ha, ish va hayot muvozanati men uchun muhim. Menimcha, ish uchun ham, dam olish uchun ham vaqt bo'lishi kerak. Agar faqat ishlasangiz, charchaysiz. Masalan, men ishdan keyin sport o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. Bu menga dam olishga yordam beradi. Bu mening sog'lig'im uchun foydali.
questions.uzSampleB2:
Ha, ish va hayot muvozanati men uchun albatta muhim. Menimcha, professional va shaxsiy hayotim o'rtasidagi sog'lom muvozanat mening umumiy farovonligimga sezilarli hissa qo'shadi. Agar men bir jihatga e'tibor bermasam, boshqasi ham zarar ko'radi.

Bunga erishish har doim ham oson emas, ayniqsa talabchan ish jadvali bilan, lekin men vaqtimni ustuvorlashtirishga va chegaralar belgilashga faol harakat qilaman. Misol uchun, men kechqurunlari va dam olish kunlari ishdan uzilishga ongli ravishda harakat qilaman, shunda men o'z sevimli mashg'ulotlarimga e'tibor qaratishim va yaqinlarim bilan vaqt o'tkazishim mumkin. Oxir oqibat, men yaxshi muvozanatga ega bo'lish hayotimning barcha sohalarida meni yanada samaraliroq va baxtliroq qiladi deb o'ylayman.

vocabulary.title: Q3 - Is work-life balance important to you?
idioms: "All work and no play" - "Faqat ish, dam olish yo'q"
sentenceStarters: "Work-life balance is absolutely crucial because..." - "Ish-hayot muvozanati juda muhim, chunki..."
"I believe that having time for..." - "Men ... uchun vaqt bo'lishi kerak deb o'ylayman..."
"When I have a good balance, I feel..." - "Yaxshi muvozanatga ega bo'lganimda, men ... his qilaman..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Work-life balance is absolutely crucial to me. I firmly believe that no job is worth sacrificing your health, relationships, or personal happiness.
In today's world, it's easy to become a workaholic. With smartphones and constant connectivity, work can follow us everywhere. I've seen people burn out because they never disconnected from work. That's not the life I want to live.
For me, balance means having time for family, friends, hobbies, and self-care alongside my professional responsibilities. When I have a good balance, I'm actually more productive at work because I'm refreshed and motivated. As the proverb says, "All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy." I think employers are increasingly recognizing this too.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Ish va hayot muvozanati men uchun juda muhim. Men hech qanday ish sog'lig'ingizni, munosabatlaringizni yoki shaxsiy baxtingizni qurbon qilishga arzimaydi, deb qat'iy ishonaman.

Bugungi kunda ishga berilib ketish oson. Smartfonlar va doimiy aloqa tufayli ish bizni hamma joyda kuzatib borishi mumkin. Men hech qachon ishdan uzilmagani uchun odamlarning charchab qolganini ko'rganman. Men bunday hayotni xohlamayman.

Men uchun muvozanat - bu professional majburiyatlarim bilan bir qatorda oila, do'stlar, sevimli mashg'ulotlar va o'zimga g'amxo'rlik qilish uchun vaqtga ega bo'lish demakdir. Muvozanatim yaxshi bo'lsa, men aslida ishda unumliroq bo'laman, chunki men tetik va motivatsiyada bo'laman. Maqolda aytilganidek, "Faqat ish va o'yin-kulgi yo'qligi odamni zerikarli qiladi". O'ylaymanki, ish beruvchilar ham buni tobora ko'proq tan olishmoqda.

questions.prompt: Compare these two pictures showing different work environments.
questions.sampleA1: This is office. And this is home. Home is good. Office is okay.
questions.sampleA2: This picture is office, and this picture is home. The office has many people, but the home has one person. I like home because it's comfortable, but the office is important too.
questions.sampleB1: These pictures show different places to work. One is an office, and the other is at home. In the office, people are working together, which is good for teamwork. However, at home, it's more quiet and you can focus better. I think both places have advantages and disadvantages, depending on what kind of work you're doing.
questions.sampleB2: Both images illustrate people engaged in work, but in very different environments. In the first picture, a young man is comfortably seated on a sofa at home, working on his laptop with a mug in his hand. He appears relaxed and wears casual clothes like jeans. In contrast, the second picture shows a bustling open-plan office. Several colleagues are seated at long, shared desks, fully focused on their computer screens. The atmosphere here is clearly more formal and dynamic. The main difference lies in the individual, relaxed setting versus a collaborative, busy workspace, highlighting the varied ways we go about our daily tasks.
questions.uzSampleA1: Bu ofis. Va bu uy. Uy yaxshi. Ofis yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleA2: Bu rasm ofis, va bu rasm uy. Ofisda ko'p odamlar bor, lekin uyda bitta odam bor. Menga uy yoqadi, chunki u qulay, lekin ofis ham muhim.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Bu rasmlar ishlash uchun turli joylarni ko'rsatadi. Biri ofis, ikkinchisi esa uyda. Ofisda odamlar birgalikda ishlashadi, bu jamoaviy ish uchun yaxshi.
Ammo, uyda tinchroq va diqqatni jamlash osonroq. Menimcha, ikkala joyning ham afzalliklari va kamchiliklari bor, bu qanday ish qilayotganingizga bog'liq.
questions.uzSampleB2: Rasmlarda zamonaviy ish joyiga ikki xil yondashuv tasvirlangan. Bir rasmda an'anaviy ofis muhitini, ikkinchisida esa uy ofisi muhitini ko'ramiz. Ofis hamkasblar o'rtasida hamkorlik va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri muloqotni rivojlantiradiganga o'xshaydi. Boshqa tomondan, uy sharoiti avtonomiya va yanada qulay muhitga ustuvor ahamiyat beradiganga o'xshaydi. Ofis yanada tuzilgan bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, uyda ishlash ko'proq moslashuvchanlikni taklif qiladi, garchi bu yolg'izlik hissini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Oxir oqibat, ideal ish muhiti, ehtimol, shaxsiy xohishlarga va ishning o'ziga xos talablariga bog'liq.

vocabulary.title: Q4 - Compare these two pictures...
idioms: different strokes for different folks - "har kim o'z yo'lini tanlaydi"
"The best of both worlds" - "Ikki dunyoning eng yaxshisi"
sentenceStarters: "The first picture shows someone working..." - "Birinchi rasmda kimdir ... da ishlayotgani ko'rsatilgan..."
"In contrast, the second image presents..." - "Aksincha, ikkinchi rasm ... ni ko'rsatmoqda..."
"Both environments have their own..." - "Ikkala muhit ham o'ziga xos ... ga ega..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
These two pictures illustrate the dramatically different work environments that have become common in today's professional world.
The first image shows someone working from home. We can see a person in a comfortable, relaxed setting with their laptop. The atmosphere appears calm and informal – they might even be in casual clothes. This represents the remote work revolution that has significantly grown in recent years, especially after the pandemic.
The second picture presents a traditional office environment. We can see people working together in a professional setting with desks, computers, and colleagues around them. The atmosphere seems more formal and structured. There's clearly more social interaction happening, with coworkers able to communicate directly.
Both environments have their own character. The home setting offers comfort and flexibility, while the office provides structure and collaboration opportunities. These images reflect the ongoing debate about the future of work. As they say, "Different strokes for different folks" – what works best really depends on the individual and the type of work they do.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Bu ikki rasm bugungi professional dunyoda keng tarqalgan keskin farq qiluvchi ish muhitlarini tasvirlaydi.

Birinchi rasmda kimdir uyda ishlayotganini ko'rishimiz mumkin. Biz odamni noutbuki bilan qulay va xotirjam muhitda ko'ramiz. Atmosfera tinch va norasmiy ko'rinadi – ular hatto kundalik kiyimda ham bo'lishi mumkin. Bu so'nggi yillarda, ayniqsa pandemiyadan keyin sezilarli darajada o'sgan masofaviy ish inqilobini ifodalaydi.

Ikkinchi rasmda an'anaviy ofis muhiti aks etgan. Biz odamlarni stol, kompyuter va atrofdagi hamkasblar bilan professional muhitda birga ishlayotganini ko'ramiz. Atmosfera ancha rasmiy va tuzilgan ko'rinadi. Hamkasblar bevosita muloqot qila olishi bilan, aniqki, ijtimoiy aloqa ko'proq.

Ikkala muhit ham o'ziga xos xususiyatlarga ega. Uy sharoiti qulaylik va moslashuvchanlikni taklif qilsa, ofis tuzilma va hamkorlik imkoniyatlarini taqdim etadi. Bu rasmlar ishning kelajagi haqidagi davom etayotgan bahsni aks ettiradi. Aytganlaridek, "Har kimning o'z didi bor" – nima eng yaxshi ishlashi, aslida, shaxsga va ular bajaradigan ish turiga bog'liq.

questions.prompt: What are the benefits of working from home?
questions.sampleA1: Home is good. Work at home. I like it. No bus.
questions.sampleA2: I like work from home. It is easy. I can stay in my house and I don't need to travel. It's good because I save money and I see my family more.
questions.sampleB1: I think working from home is good. For example, you don't have to go to the office, so you save time. Also, it can be more comfortable because you are in your own house. However, sometimes it's difficult to focus because there are distractions.
questions.sampleB2: Well, there are quite a few perks, to be fair. The biggest one for me would be cutting out the daily commute, which saves you loads of time and stress. On top of that, you get far more flexibility over your schedule, and you can work in comfort. Honestly, most people find they get through their tasks quicker without all the office distractions.
questions.uzSampleA1: Uy yaxshi. Uyda ishlash. Menga yoqadi. Avtobus yo'q.
questions.uzSampleA2: Menga uyda ishlash yoqadi. Bu oson. Men uyimda qolishim mumkin va sayohat qilishimga hojat yo'q. Bu yaxshi, chunki men pulni tejayman va oilamni ko'proq ko'raman.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, uyda ishlash yaxshi.
Masalan, ofisga borishingizga hojat yo'q, shuning uchun vaqtni tejaysiz. Bundan tashqari, bu qulayroq bo'lishi mumkin, chunki siz o'z uyingizdasiz.
Biroq, ba'zida diqqatni jamlash qiyin, chunki chalg'ituvchi narsalar bor.
questions.uzSampleB2: Uyda ishlashning bir nechta afzalliklari bor. Birinchidan, u ko'proq moslashuvchanlikni ta'minlaydi, bu esa odamlarga o'z vaqtlarini samaraliroq boshqarishga va ishni shaxsiy majburiyatlar bilan muvozanatlashga imkon beradi. Ikkinchidan, har kuni qatnash zarurati yo'qligi vaqt va pulni tejaydi, stressni kamaytiradi va hayot sifatini yaxshilashga hissa qo'shadi. Bundan tashqari, ko'p odamlar tanish va shaxsiy muhitda yaxshiroq diqqatni jamlay olishlarini aniqlaydilar, bu esa mahsuldorlikning oshishiga olib keladi. Biroq, ish va shaxsiy hayot o'rtasida aniq chegaralarni saqlash qiyin bo'lishi mumkinligini tan olish muhim.

vocabulary.title: Q5 - What are the benefits of working from home?
idioms: home is where the heart is - "uy yurak bo'lgan joyda"
"In the comfort of one's own home" - "O'z uyining qulayligida"
sentenceStarters: "One of the main benefits is..." - "Asosiy afzalliklardan biri..."
"Working from home allows people to..." - "Uydan ishlash odamlarga ... imkonini beradi..."
"Many people find they're more productive because..." - "Ko'p odamlar o'zlarini yanada samarali deb bilishadi, chunki..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Working from home offers numerous significant benefits that have made it increasingly popular in recent years.
Firstly, and perhaps most importantly, there's the flexibility it provides. You can often set your own schedule, take breaks when needed, and work during your most productive hours. This is particularly valuable for parents or those with other responsibilities.
Secondly, working from home eliminates the daily commute. This saves significant time and money – no more sitting in traffic or crowded public transport. That extra hour or two can be spent sleeping, exercising, or with family.
Additionally, many people find they're more productive at home without office distractions – no colleagues interrupting, no unnecessary meetings, no office noise. You can create your ideal work environment.
Furthermore, remote work offers better work-life balance. You can easily handle personal tasks during breaks and spend more time with family. As the saying goes, "Home is where the heart is," and for many, working where they feel most comfortable leads to greater job satisfaction.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Uyda ishlash so'nggi yillarda tobora ommalashib borishiga sabab bo'lgan ko'plab muhim afzalliklarni taqdim etadi.

Birinchidan, va ehtimol eng muhimi, bu taqdim etadigan moslashuvchanlikdir. Ko'pincha o'z jadvalingizni belgilashingiz, kerak bo'lganda tanaffuslar qilishingiz va eng samarali soatlaringizda ishlashingiz mumkin. Bu, ayniqsa, ota-onalar yoki boshqa majburiyatlari borlar uchun juda qimmatli.

Ikkinchidan, uyda ishlash kundalik qatnovni yo'q qiladi. Bu sezilarli vaqt va pulni tejaydi - endi tirbandlikda yoki gavjum jamoat transportida o'tirish yo'q. Qo'shimcha bir yoki ikki soatni uxlash, mashq qilish yoki oila bilan o'tkazish mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, ko'p odamlar ofisdagi chalg'ituvchi omillarsiz uyda ko'proq samarali ekanliklarini aniqlaydilar - hamkasblar xalaqit bermaydi, keraksiz uchrashuvlar yo'q, ofis shovqini yo'q. Siz o'zingizning ideal ish muhitingizni yaratishingiz mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, masofaviy ish yaxshiroq ish va hayot muvozanatini taklif etadi. Tanaffuslarda shaxsiy vazifalarni osongina hal qilishingiz va oila bilan ko'proq vaqt o'tkazishingiz mumkin. Aytishlaricha, "Uy - yurak joylashgan joy", va ko'pchilik uchun o'zlarini eng qulay his qiladigan joyda ishlash ishdan ko'proq qoniqishga olib keladi.

questions.prompt: Why might some people prefer working in an office?
questions.sampleA1: I like office. Office is good. Work is there.
questions.sampleA2: Some people like office. Because they can see friends. And work is different from home. But home is nice too.
questions.sampleB1: Well, I think some people prefer working in an office because it's easier to focus. At home, there are many distractions, like TV or family. Also, it's good to see your colleagues and talk to them. However, working from home can be more comfortable.
questions.sampleB2: Well, I suppose a lot of people prefer the office because it gives them a proper structure to the day. For one thing, it's much easier to draw a line between work and home life. On top of that, there's the social side — you can chat with colleagues and bounce ideas around, which honestly makes the day fly by.
questions.uzSampleA1: Men ofisni yaxshi ko'raman. Ofis yaxshi. Ish u yerda.
questions.uzSampleA2: Ba'zi odamlarga ofis yoqadi. Chunki ular do'stlarni ko'rishlari mumkin. Va ish uyidan farq qiladi. Lekin uy ham yaxshi.
questions.uzSampleB1:
Xo'sh, menimcha, ba'zi odamlar ofisda ishlashni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki u yerda diqqatni jamlash osonroq. Uyda televizor yoki oila kabi ko'plab chalg'ituvchi omillar bor. Bundan tashqari, hamkasblaringizni ko'rish va ular bilan gaplashish yaxshi.
Shunga qaramay, uyda ishlash qulayroq bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleB2: Odamlar hali ham ofisda ishlashni afzal ko'rishlarining bir nechta sabablari bor. Birinchidan, u uyda tez-tez uchraydigan chalg'ituvchi omillardan xoli, maxsus ish joyini ta'minlashi mumkin. Bu ba'zilar uchun unumdorlikning oshishiga olib kelishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ofis hayotining ijtimoiy jihati ko'pchilik uchun muhim; hamkasblar bilan yuzma-yuz muloqot qilish imkoniyati jamoatchilik tuyg'usini rivojlantirishi va jamoaning birdamligini yaxshilashi mumkin. Masofaviy ish moslashuvchanlikni taklif qilsa-da, ofis muhitining tuzilishi va ijtimoiy muloqoti ko'plab odamlar uchun jozibador bo'lib qolmoqda.

vocabulary.title: Q6 - Why might some people prefer working in an office?
idioms: on the same page - "bir xil fikrda bo'lmoq"
phrases: separation between work and home - "ish va uy o'rtasidagi ajratish"
sentenceStarters: "Many people prefer offices because..." - "Ko'p odamlar ofislarni afzal ko'rishadi, chunki..."
"The office environment provides..." - "Ofis muhiti ... ta'minlaydi..."
"For some, the social aspect of..." - "Ba'zilar uchun ... ning ijtimoiy tomoni..."

questions.sampleAnswer:
Despite the rise of remote work, many people still prefer the traditional office environment for several valid reasons.
Firstly, offices provide a clear separation between work and home life. When you leave the office, work stays behind. At home, it can be difficult to "switch off" when your workspace is also your living space. This physical boundary is important for many people's mental health.
Secondly, offices offer social interaction that humans naturally crave. Chatting with colleagues, having lunch together, and building friendships at work all contribute to job satisfaction. Working from home can be isolating and lonely for some people.
Additionally, offices often provide better infrastructure – faster internet, proper desks and chairs, meeting rooms, and IT support. Not everyone has a suitable home workspace.
Furthermore, collaboration and creativity often flourish in person. Spontaneous conversations and brainstorming sessions happen naturally in offices. As they say, "Great things in business are never done by one person; they're done by a team." Some work simply requires face-to-face interaction.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Masofaviy ishning ommalashganiga qaramay, ko'pchilik odamlar bir qator asosli sabablarga ko'ra an'anaviy ofis muhitini afzal ko'rishadi.

Birinchidan, ofislar ish va uy hayoti o'rtasida aniq chegarani ta'minlaydi. Ofisdan ketganingizda, ish ortda qoladi. Uyda esa, ish joyingiz ham yashash joyingiz bo'lsa, "o'chish" qiyin bo'lishi mumkin. Bu jismoniy chegara ko'pchilikning ruhiy salomatligi uchun muhimdir.

Ikkinchidan, ofislar insonlar tabiiy ravishda istaydigan ijtimoiy muloqotni taklif etadi. Hamkasblar bilan suhbatlashish, birgalikda tushlik qilish va ishda do'stlik o'rnatish - bularning barchasi ishdan qoniqishga hissa qo'shadi. Uyda ishlash ba'zi odamlar uchun yolg'izlik va izolyatsiyaga olib kelishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, ofislar ko'pincha yaxshiroq infratuzilmani ta'minlaydi – tezroq internet, mos keladigan stol va stullar, yig'ilish xonalari va IT-qo'llab-quvvatlash. Hamma ham mos keladigan uy ish joyiga ega emas.

Bundan tashqari, hamkorlik va ijodkorlik ko'pincha shaxsan gullab-yashnaydi. Ofislarda o'z-o'zidan suhbatlar va g'oyalar bilan hujum qilish seanslari tabiiy ravishda sodir bo'ladi. Aytishlaricha, "Biznesdagi buyuk narsalar hech qachon bir kishi tomonidan qilinmaydi; ular jamoa tomonidan qilinadi." Ba'zi ishlar shunchaki yuzma-yuz muloqotni talab qiladi.

questions.prompt: Describe someone whose job you find interesting.
questions.sampleA1: My friend. He is a cook. He makes food. I like his job.
questions.sampleA2: My sister is a nurse. I think her job is interesting because she helps people. She works in a hospital. It is hard work, but she likes it. And she is very good at it.
questions.sampleB1: I think my neighbor's job is interesting. He's a software developer. He works from home, which is cool. I think it's interesting because he gets to create new things with computers. For example, he told me he's working on a new app. I don't really understand it, but it sounds very complicated.
questions.sampleB2: I'd like to talk about my uncle, who works as a commercial airline pilot, because I've always thought his job was absolutely fascinating. He flies long-haul routes for a major carrier, mostly between Europe and Asia, so he's constantly jetting off to different corners of the world. As for what the job actually involves, it's a lot more than just flying the plane. He has to go through detailed safety checks before every flight, monitor the weather, plan the route and keep in close contact with air traffic control. On top of that, he's responsible for the safety of hundreds of passengers, which is a huge amount of pressure to take on. He once told me that the hardest part isn't the flying at all — it's staying calm and keeping a cool head when something unexpected crops up. The reason I find it so interesting is the sheer variety. No two days are the same, and he gets to wake up in a different city every week, which sounds incredibly exciting to me. I also admire the level of skill and responsibility involved; you really can't cut corners in a job like that. To be honest, part of me is a little envious, because he genuinely loves what he does. That said, I don't think I could put up with the downsides — the jet lag, the time away from family and the irregular hours would probably wear me down. Still, I have enormous respect for him, and I suppose he's a great example of someone who's truly found their calling.

Noldan nimadirni tasavvur qila olish va keyin uning aniq bir tuzilmaga aylanishini ko'rish juda katta mukofot bo'lishi kerak. bulletPoints: Describe someone whose job you find interesting.
What is their job and what do they do?
Why do you find it interesting?
questions.sampleAnswer:
I'd like to talk about my cousin who works as a wildlife photographer for National Geographic. I find his job absolutely fascinating.
His work involves traveling to remote locations around the world to photograph animals in their natural habitats. He's been to African savannas, Amazon rainforests, and Arctic regions. His job requires incredible patience – sometimes he waits for days to capture the perfect shot. He also needs extensive knowledge about animal behavior to predict their movements.
What I find most interesting about his job is the combination of art, adventure, and purpose. His photographs aren't just beautiful – they raise awareness about endangered species and environmental issues. Each image tells a story that can inspire people to care about conservation.
Would I like to do this job? Part of me says yes – the adventure and creativity are incredibly appealing. However, it requires spending months away from family, often in uncomfortable or even dangerous conditions. I greatly admire his dedication, but I think I prefer a more stable lifestyle. As they say, "Find what you love and let it kill you" – he's found his calling, and I respect that immensely.
questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men National Geographic uchun yovvoyi tabiat fotosuratchisi bo'lib ishlaydigan amakivachcham haqida gapirmoqchiman. Men uning ishini juda qiziqarli deb bilaman.

Uning ishi dunyo bo'ylab olis joylarga sayohat qilib, hayvonlarni o'zining tabiiy yashash joylarida suratga olishni o'z ichiga oladi. U Afrika savannalarida, Amazon o'rmonlarida va Arktika hududlarida bo'lgan. Uning ishi aql bovar qilmas sabr-toqatni talab qiladi – ba'zan u mukammal suratni olish uchun kunlab kutadi. Shuningdek, u hayvonlarning harakatini bashorat qilish uchun ularning xulq-atvori haqida keng bilimga ega bo'lishi kerak.

Uning ishi haqida meni eng qiziqtiradigan narsa - bu san'at, sarguzasht va maqsadning kombinatsiyasi. Uning fotosuratlari nafaqat go'zal, balki ular yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida turgan turlar va atrof-muhit muammolari haqida xabardorlikni oshiradi. Har bir rasm odamlarni tabiatni muhofaza qilishga undashi mumkin bo'lgan hikoyani aytib beradi.

Men bu ishni qilishni xohlarmidim? Mening bir qismim ha deydi – sarguzasht va ijodkorlik juda jozibali. Biroq, bu oiladan oylab uzoqda, ko'pincha noqulay yoki hatto xavfli sharoitlarda vaqt o'tkazishni talab qiladi. Men uning fidoyiligiga juda qoyil qolaman, lekin menimcha, men barqarorroq turmush tarzini afzal ko'raman. Aytishlaricha, "O'zingizga yoqqan narsani toping va unga sizni o'ldirishga qo'ying" – u o'zining chaqirig'ini topdi va men buni juda hurmat qilaman.

questions.prompt: Working From Home Is Better Than Working in an Office
questions.sampleA1: I like home. Work at home is good. I don't like office. Office is bad.
questions.sampleA2: I like working from home because it is comfortable. I can wear my pajamas. But the office is good too because I can see my friends. And the coffee is free at the office.
questions.sampleB1: I think working from home is better for me. I can wake up later and I don't have to travel. Also, I can make my own lunch, which is cheaper and healthier. However, sometimes it's hard to focus at home because there are distractions. So, maybe the office is better for some people.
questions.sampleB2: This is a topic that divides opinion, and honestly I can see the arguments on both sides. On the one hand, there's a strong case for working from home. The most obvious benefit is that you do away with the daily commute, which frees up a huge chunk of time and cuts down on stress. You also get far more flexibility over your hours, and many people find they can crack on with their work far more productively without colleagues constantly interrupting them. On the other hand, working in an office does have its merits. For a start, it draws a clear line between your professional and personal life, so you can properly switch off once you get home. There's also the social side to consider — being surrounded by colleagues makes it much easier to bounce ideas around, build relationships and feel part of a team. Some people, quite frankly, find working from home lonely and struggle to stay motivated when they're on their own all day. As for my own view, I'd say it really boils down to the individual and the type of work involved. Personally, I think a hybrid arrangement is the way forward — a couple of days at home for focused work and the rest in the office for meetings and collaboration. That way, you genuinely get the best of both worlds. So while I wouldn't say one is flatly better than the other, I do think blanket statements like this rarely hold up in practice.

Biroq, ba'zida uyda diqqatni jamlash qiyin, chunki chalg'itadigan narsalar bor. Shunday ekan, ehtimol ofis ba'zi odamlar uchun yaxshiroqdir.

Siz har kuni qatnashdan qochishingiz va o'zingizning ehtiyojlaringizga mos keladigan ish joyini yaratishingiz mumkin. Boshqa tomondan, ofis hamkorlik va jamoani shakllantirish uchun foydali bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan tuzilgan muhitni ta'minlaydi. questions.sampleAnswer:
The debate over whether working from home is better than office work has become one of the most discussed topics in the modern workplace. Let me examine both perspectives.
Supporters of remote work highlight several advantages. Firstly, eliminating the daily commute saves valuable time and reduces stress – no more traffic jams or crowded trains. Secondly, working from home offers greater flexibility to balance professional and personal responsibilities. Parents can be present for their children, and everyone can work during their most productive hours. Additionally, many people report fewer distractions at home and higher productivity. Companies also save money on office space and utilities.
On the other hand, office advocates make compelling points too. The office provides a clear boundary between work and home life – when you leave, work stays behind. Furthermore, face-to-face collaboration often leads to better creativity and teamwork. Spontaneous conversations can spark innovative ideas. The social aspect is also crucial – humans need interaction, and isolation can lead to loneliness and mental health issues. Moreover, some jobs simply require physical presence.
In my opinion, the best solution is a hybrid model – combining the benefits of both. Working from home a few days and in the office others could offer flexibility while maintaining team connections. As the saying goes, "The best of both worlds." The future of work is likely to be flexible rather than fixed.

Masofaviy ish tarafdorlari bir nechta afzalliklarni ta'kidlashadi. Birinchidan, har kuni ishga borish vaqtni tejaydi va stressni kamaytiradi – endi tirbandliklar yoki gavjum poezdlar yo'q. Ikkinchidan, uyda ishlash professional va shaxsiy mas'uliyatlarni muvozanatlash uchun ko'proq moslashuvchanlikni taqdim etadi. Ota-onalar farzandlari bilan birga bo'lishlari mumkin va har kim o'zining eng samarali soatlarida ishlashi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ko'p odamlar uyda kamroq chalg'ituvchi omillar va yuqori mahsuldorlik haqida xabar berishadi. Kompaniyalar, shuningdek, ofis maydoni va kommunal xizmatlarga pul tejashadi.

Boshqa tomondan, ofis tarafdorlari ham ishonarli dalillarni keltirishadi. Ofis ish va uy hayoti o'rtasida aniq chegara yaratadi – ketganingizda, ish ortda qoladi. Bundan tashqari, yuzma-yuz hamkorlik ko'pincha yaxshiroq ijodkorlik va jamoaviy ishga olib keladi. O'z-o'zidan bo'ladigan suhbatlar innovatsion g'oyalarni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin. Ijtimoiy jihat ham muhim – odamlarga muloqot kerak va yakkalik yolg'izlik va ruhiy salomatlik muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ba'zi ishlar shunchaki jismoniy hozir bo'lishni talab qiladi.

Mening fikrimcha, eng yaxshi yechim – bu gibrid model – ikkalasining ham afzalliklarini birlashtirish. Bir necha kun uyda va boshqa kunlari ofisda ishlash jamoa aloqalarini saqlab qolgan holda moslashuvchanlikni ta'minlashi mumkin. Aytganidek, "Ikki dunyoning eng yaxshisi". Ishning kelajagi qat'iy emas, balki moslashuvchan bo'lishi mumkin.
